description: The pick-list. Each panel declares what it REQUIRES, so a method can be checked for feasibility before any data is read and the user is told up front which panels will be blank and why.

panels.title: Intensity vs retention time
panels.notes: Always valid. Log y: intensity spans five orders of magnitude in real cohorts.

panels.title: Drift vs retention time
panels.notes: Blank for DDA (drift null). EXCLUDED for SONAR: its drift column is a quadrupole window position, not a drift time.

panels.title: m/z vs drift
panels.notes: Density/hexbin, not scatter: this is where ion count bites hardest.

panels.title: SeqStart vs intensity
panels.notes: Primary cluster only (cluster_rank 1); pooling clusters corrupts the pattern. Y is per-protein choice: within-protein max for stable proteins, absolute log where a real anomaly must stay visible.

panels.title: Ion flight (animated)

degrades_without.to: 2-D: m/z against RT, mobility axis collapsed

panels.notes: Replay of the event track. Honours decimation and shows the kept/total ratio.

panels.title: Top3avg percentile across samples
panels.notes: Percentile, not rank. A densely packed distribution moves a protein several rank positions on measurement noise alone.

panels.title: Protein stoichiometry ratios
panels.notes: Ratios only within one run. Carries n_peptides_used on both sides: a 1-peptide vs 3-peptide ratio is not the same measurement.

panels.title: Flux across runs
panels.notes: Needs a stated normalization. Raw Top3avg across runs mixes biology with loading.

panels.title: Ion map to sample class
panels.notes: The HeLa/K562 question. Holds out by batch, never randomly: a random split lets the model read instrument and loading instead of cell line.

panels.title: Forensic track of one ion
panels.notes: The event ledger as a timeline, with coordinate at each hop. Same data the flight animation replays.
